meta.evidence_status: PROPOSED DESIGN (dimensioned concept; catalogue parts as envelopes; nothing built)

axis: board frame: x right, y away from the writer, z up; origin at the board's front-left corner on the writing surface

guided_area.note: full force here; printed practice sheets keep 15 mm margins (ASSUMPTION)

head_z_travel.note: top = working (gap 2.7 mm to the paper top), bottom = retracted/off

components.label: Base plate
components.function: Stiff aluminium floor of the board; everything mounts to it.

components.label: Left wall
components.function: Side wall; carries the glass edge.

components.label: Right wall
components.function: Side wall; carries the glass edge.

components.label: Front wall
components.function: Front wall under the writer's forearm.

components.label: Glass writing surface
components.function: 2 mm strengthened glass: flat, hard writing surface that lets the magnetic field through.
components.part: custom: chemically strengthened glass 2.0 mm, anti-shatter film

components.label: Paper (A4)
components.function: An ordinary sheet; practice sheets are printed with corner marks and pushed against the paper stop.

components.label: Paper stop
components.function: L-shaped stop that places the sheet where the app expects it.

components.label: Back housing (top cover)
components.function: Covers the motors and the electronics; also a pen ledge.

components.label: Y rail (MGN12)
components.function: Steel guide for the gantry (front-back).

components.label: Y block (MGN12H)
components.function: Carriage block of the gantry.

components.label: Y rail (MGN12)
components.function: Steel guide for the gantry (front-back).

components.label: Y block (MGN12H)
components.function: Carriage block of the gantry.

components.label: Gantry beam
components.function: Aluminium beam that moves front-back and carries the X rail.

components.label: X rail (MGN9)
components.function: Steel guide for the carriage (left-right).

components.label: X block (MGN9H)
components.function: Carriage block.

components.label: Carriage plate and cantilever
components.function: Aluminium plate on the X block; its arm reaches 25 mm toward the writer to hold the head beside the rail.

components.label: Stepper motor A
components.function: Drives one CoreXY belt; together they move the head anywhere under the page.

components.label: Stepper motor B
components.function: Drives one CoreXY belt; together they move the head anywhere under the page.

components.label: Belt idler
components.function: Turns the belt at the front corners.

components.label: Belt idler
components.function: Turns the belt at the front corners.

components.label: Belt (left run)
components.function: GT2 6 mm belt of motor A.

components.label: Belt (right run)
components.function: GT2 6 mm belt of motor B.

components.label: Head magnet
components.function: Permanent magnet under the glass. Where it sits relative to the pen's magnet sets the pull on the pen: direction and strength.

components.label: Magnet cup on the Z parallelogram
components.function: Aluminium cup; a parallelogram keeps the magnet upright while it is lowered by up to 12 mm.

components.label: Hall sensor ring
components.function: Eight 3-axis Hall sensors around the head: they measure where the pen's magnet is, 1000 times a second.
components.part: custom PCB with 8 x TI TMAG5170A2

components.label: Z-lift servo
components.function: Raises and lowers the head magnet: the guidance level, and off.

components.label: Main board
components.function: nRF54L15 (Bluetooth to the pen and the phone), two TMC2209 motor drivers, the safety monitor.

components.label: 24 V input and power switch
components.function: Input from the external 24 V adaptor; power switch.

components.label: Stop button
components.function: Stops the motors and lowers the head at once (hardware cut of the driver enable lines).

components.label: Arm-rest wedge (optional)
components.function: The writing surface is about 45 mm above the desk; the wedge supports the forearm.
components.part: custom: PU foam in a PA12 shell

pen_magnet.location: keel under the FIXED front sleeve of the Rev H pen (moves with the handle, not the nose)
pen_magnet.magnetisation: along the pen axis, north toward the pen's rear

pen_frame_mm.axis: Rev H frame: z along the pen axis from the ball

pen_magnet.why_not_on_the_nose: the nose actuator carries only 0.21 N continuously on a 12 N/m suspension (results/revH/tip_params.json)
pen_magnet.label: MFR (magnet) + ASSUMPTION/CALC (placement, to confirm in Rev H CAD)

explainer_numbers.label: What the board pulls
explainer_numbers.text: a 6.35 mm magnet in a small keel under the fixed sleeve, about 16.5 mm behind the ball and 3.8 mm above the paper, so it moves the whole pen, not the nose

explainer_numbers.label: Pull limit
explainer_numbers.text: 0.4 N, about the weight of 40 g (a safety setting)

explainer_numbers.label: Strongest pull the magnets could give
explainer_numbers.text: 1.2 N; the limit keeps it gentle

explainer_numbers.label: How far a relaxed hand moves
explainer_numbers.text: about 0.76 mm for every 0.1 N of steady pull, so about 3 mm at the limit; 0.36 mm per 0.1 N if you resist a little

explainer_numbers.label: Tracing a letter, ink off the letter (relaxed writer)
explainer_numbers.text: board off 1.49 mm, full guidance 0.63 mm

explainer_numbers.label: With the nose also correcting the ink
If you push against it
explainer_numbers.text: the pull fades away when the pen stays more than 4 mm off the letter for 0.3 s, and comes back slowly
